title: Lennus: Kodai Kikai no Kioku
description: In the small town of Reiyold, a great magic potential was found within the mind of a small child named Chenzi. With much joy and some sadness, Chenzi's mother sent him to attend the Magic School. Having a natural talent for magic, Chenzi quickly became one of the school's top students. However, he will soon learn that having a 'special gift' may sometimes do more harm than good. Unknowingly, Chenzi embarks on a dare that will bring about the demise of all life as he knows it.
